nodes.label: Shared Dining Table with Multiple Appetizer Plates
nodes.description: A top-down angled shot of a dark marble restaurant table set for a group dining experience. Multiple small plates and shared dishes are spread across the surface: a wire fry basket on a wooden tray holding golden fried croquettes or arancini with lemon wedges, accompanied by two dipping sauces; a striped ceramic plate with crispy fried pieces garnished with microgreens and a light sauce; a teal ceramic plate with a fried or baked item; and a partially eaten dish in a wide bowl. Red wine and water glasses are visible in the background, and diners' hands are seen reaching in, conveying an active, communal meal in progress. The mood is warm, social, and upscale-casual. Visual style is editorial food photography with shallow depth of field and moody low-key lighting. Purpose on restaurant website: showcases the shared-plates dining concept, appetizer variety, and lively group atmosphere to attract diners seeking a sociable fine-casual experience.
